newsitem.title: NORWAY: Transocean in rig deal with Texaco.
newsitem.headline: Transocean in rig deal with Texaco.

text.p: Offshore services company Transocean ASA said on Tuesday it had signed new 12-month contracts with Texaco Exploration and Production Inc for the hire of two rigs worth a combined $58.4 million.

Transocean said the contract covered the Sonat D-F 96 and Sonat D-F 97. The contracts will begin immediately upon conclusion of current contract commitments, the company said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
Both contracts possess an incentive drilling opportunity, which could generate additional revenues over the contract period.

Transocean said the Sonat D-G 97 would undergo a water depth upgrade to 2,350 feet, which was expected to result in no more than seven days downtime. A similar upgrade was completed on the Sonat D-G 96 in January.
